verdict.rationale: The 01 is a voice-driven computer-control platform that claims it can control third-party software, so how it locates UI elements is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence describes its element-location approach (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, or coordinates), and nothing covers debugging misclicks.

support.subject: As a developer, the approach to locating UI elements (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, coordinates) is documented, so misclicks are debuggable
